next.reason: 1985: 'The maximum number of characters allowed in the character-string is 30.' §2023:13.18.40.3 SR4: 'The maximum number of characters allowed in character-string-1 is 63', and §2023:13.18.40.3 SR6 counts a constant-name repetition factor by its integer's length. A character-string of 31 to 63 characters, refused in 1985, is accepted. Both are compile-time limits.
